blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A son of slain journalist Percival “Percy Lapid” Mabasa has been in custody for more than a week now of US immigration authorities in California, more than three years since his family sought asylum due to death threats. Mark Mabasa, son of the hard-hitting radio broadcaster who was assassinated in 2022, has been in detention at Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) facility in California since Sept. 21, according to his uncle Roy Mabasa, also a journalist.
